sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Amelia, a communications engineer, carries the dream of connecting the whole land through communication.

She mustered all her courage, affirmed her ideal, and now works hard to make it real.

sections.title: Token
sections.text: A few spare antennas. Slender and easily bent, yet you know these little things can connect person to person — and the whole land.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: A communications technology engineer whose research has already been applied to Rim Billiton's long-range communication systems. She has now joined Rhodes Island's Engineering Department, providing technical support for long-range communications at the Rhodes Island base.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Timeslot shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L

During her physical examination, the medical Operators discovered that the feathered beast constantly at Timeslot's side was not a mechanical feathered beast at all, but a lively, living little feathered beast — and one of the kind that can mimic human speech, no less.
No matter how the Operators tried to coax it, the feathered beast kept its beak primly shut — until it saw Timeslot, eyes brimming with tears, being reassured over and over by the medical Operators not to be nervous. At that, the creature finally opened its beak and spoke its first words: "Pathetic."
The tears in Timeslot's eyes promptly welled up even more!

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text:
When Operator Timeslot first joined the Engineering Department, she remained stiff and overly formal for a long while. She would often ask whether she ought to make coffee for her team leader or her superiors, or help them sort their documents, and even after the other Operators told her none of that was necessary, she still could not set her mind at ease.
Closure — in Timeslot's eyes, "the big boss right above me, my direct superior" — took her, the very day after she finished her new-hire training and formally joined the Engineering Department, into a laboratory set aside solely for her research into Rhodes Island's long-range communication technology, equipped with every instrument she could need. Closure herself not only listened attentively as Timeslot stammered her way through every one of her technical ideas, but even pulled an all-nighter alongside her to finish the job when setting up the experimental environment did not go smoothly. After all of that, Timeslot finally relaxed completely.
At meals in the canteen she would tell Angelina, "I really love it here!"; back in the dorms she would tell Jacinta and Tani, "I'm so happy here! I get to do everything I want to do!" Even the Procurement Department Operators reported that the number of tissues Timeslot bought for wiping away tears had dropped considerably. Everything was moving in a good direction, and everyone was glad to see Operator Timeslot turn into the bright, lively person she is now.
A few weeks later, however, we once again found Operator Timeslot sitting in the canteen, eyes brimming with tears, the very picture of dejected misery. An HR Department Operator, alarmed, went over to ask what was wrong. Timeslot held it in as long as she could, then finally gave her reason while wiping her eyes:
“我的工作量还有加班时间……怎么反而比之前还多了好几倍不止啊！！呜！”

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text:
【Laboratory Surveillance Footage】
"Operator Timeslot, we booked a tour of the long-range communications lab for today. Are you busy right now?"
“……时隙干员？”
“……时隙干员，你在吗……？”
(Footsteps)
"S-sob, sob sob sob!
"Please, Little Flybug, please, staff, please, comms core!
"Hurry up and get better, hurry up and work properly!"
"Operator Timeslot, why are you kneeling on the floor?! Get up, get up, the floor's freezing!"
"Sob, sob! I'm begging you all, please just start working!"

【Rhodes Island Salon Surveillance Footage】
“一泵护发素、两泵护发素、三泵护发素、四泵护发素……！
“怎、怎么头发还是这样干巴巴的……”
“呜，没事的澄闪小姐，我的头发一直都是这样……”
"Miss Timeslot, just wait a little longer, I'll go look for some hair oil. I'll definitely get your hair smooth!
"By the way, Miss Timeslot, your hair color is lovely. Everywhere else is brown, but just these two braids and the bangs above them are pure white!"
“其实本来都是棕色的……可能是因为压力一大我就拽自己的辫子，所以它们就变白了……”
“啊……”

【Meeting Room Work Footage】
"Operator Timeslot, you're up next to present. Please get ready!"
"O-okay!
“深、深呼吸，别紧张，最后一次排练：大家好我是今天来宣讲的时隙，我的主、主题是、是……
"Ah, I'm done for, done for, done for!"
……
"Medical Operator! Medical Operator! Operator Timeslot's face looks like it's frozen solid!"

As part of a recent Operator mental health care initiative, and on the basis of these recordings, an HR Department Operator arranged counseling for Timeslot, covering whether she felt under excessive pressure in her work at Rhodes Island, whether she needed help, and so on. Timeslot, however, only told the HR Operator — shyly and apologetically — that her current state was in fact far better than before, and that those behaviors were merely habits left over from earlier days.
After the session ended and Timeslot left the counseling room, the HR Operator found several slender replacement communication antennas she had absentmindedly left behind on her seat. Evidently, right up until she came to the counseling room, Timeslot had still been in her laboratory, carrying on with her research.
As the counseling results showed, Timeslot is far stronger and far more resolute than she appears — much like those tiny antennas: so slender that they always look about to snap in the next second, yet able to link city to city, and perhaps one day country to country as well.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text:
HR Department rumor 1: The Trans-Redsoil Company has appointed a new Director of Engineering — one who, according to their CEO, will "revolutionize long-range communication technology within a month."
HR Department rumor 2: It has now been three months since the Trans-Redsoil Company's CEO made that bold declaration.
HR Department rumor 3: The Trans-Redsoil Company's Director of Engineering was sighted finishing his overtime in the dead of night, sitting forlornly at the roadside (later confirmed not to be finishing at all — he had merely come downstairs for some air in the middle of his overtime).

Since Operator Timeslot resigned from the Trans-Redsoil Company, both the rumors and the job postings they have since put out make it plain that they are stuck, unable to achieve any real technological iteration. And the very Operator Timeslot who might have been able to help them is right now sitting in our Engineering Department office, leafing through the latest Rim Billiton newspaper, whose front-page headline reads: "Amelia, Who Repaired Every Communication Tower Single-Handedly — Just How Did She Do It?"
The article lists any number of reasons — timing, ability, luck and so on — but if you were to ask Operator Timeslot herself, she managed it for one reason alone: a child's small, tender wish.
As a child, Timeslot would see her mother off to work at the mine each day, then wait a whole daytime and most of the night before she could finally tell her mother — home at last from her shift — everything that had happened that day. Sometimes she was too tired and fell asleep, and when she woke again she would always have forgotten one or two of the things she had meant to say.
Once she started school, and later got into university, the wait grew longer still: it took time for a courier to carry the letters she wrote all the way to her mother in the mining district, and her thrifty mother's replies took longer yet to reach her. She always learned her mother had been ill only after she had already recovered, and her mother could only comfort her — alone and far from home — long after she had cried in secret.
“要是能更快一点把想说的话传递给妈妈就好了”，时隙就是怀揣着这样的愿望，从矿场到小镇，从小镇到大城市，从大城市再到工作的企业……可时间没有等待她。“我一定会出人头地，一定会成为妈妈的骄傲的。”——在二代远程通讯成功通过审核时，时隙在测试阶段给母亲的终端发送的信息。母亲已经不能再收到她的消息了，但她知道测试消息会作为初始数据一直保留在系统之中，这代表着自己努力的成果，也代表着给母亲的承诺永远也不会变，不论是十年、二十年，她都会像承诺的那样继续努力，努力成为一个更厉害的人，成为可以让母亲放心的女儿，成为一个骄傲。

“妈妈，你看，我做到了……报纸上登我的名字了！”编辑好消息，犹豫了很久之后，时隙最终摁下了发送键，发出了这条消息。

sections.title: Archive File 4
sections.text:
Speaking of Operator Timeslot's work since arriving at Rhodes Island, besides her contributions to Rhodes Island's long-range communications, there is one thing that simply must be mentioned: the business she has started with Operator Jacinta. Lately, though, it has been causing her no end of grief — the "startup team" the two of them formed keeps running into one problem after another:
比如第一站拉特兰，虽然距离雷姆必拓很近，但这里的风土人情和雷姆必拓大不相同。为了让拉特兰人听一下她们的企划，两人先是不间断地品尝了八十多种甜点拉近关系，又绞尽脑汁回答了“远程通讯要是能和共感结合一下就更好了”的问题，最终得到了枢机的“会再联络”的答复。又比如为了和维多利亚的贵族接洽，两人苦学了好几天社交礼仪，更别提在萨尔贡她们还没有说两句就被拉去观摩新一轮的族长选拔、米诺斯人坚称远程通讯还不如他们长跑送信更快、哥伦比亚的企业言辞犀利地指出两人的团队“根本不具备合作的资质”……
在四处碰壁后，时隙在工程部偷偷抹眼泪苦恼应该怎样推进创业，被路过的可露希尔看到，塞给了她一本据说是呕心沥血亲自编写的大作《卖货方法论》。时隙从此开始不论吃饭还是休息都捧着这本册子不断翻阅，甚至开始拜托干员联络上拜松试图获取创业经验，诗怀雅据说也被她咨询过多次……
After tireless effort, Operator Timeslot took up the proposal she and Jacinta had spent many days preparing and, trembling all over, began her practice presentation — but what appeared before any of the content were the tears in her eyes. According to Operator Raidian, who happened to pass by the rehearsal, the material Timeslot had written was in fact already quite good. After some discussion, the audience finally decided to ask Swire to put Operator Timeslot through special training in her free time, in the hope of giving her enough presence to win the other side over.
It may all look terribly rough going right now, but who knows — perhaps one day we will have yet another renowned entrepreneur among us!

sections.title: Promotion Record
sections.text:
Thinking it over carefully, Timeslot realized that this little feathered beast at her side had apparently been keeping her company for a great many years.
最开始是她小时候摔了一跤，正坐在地上哭，这只小羽兽也不太会飞，在空中被气流吹翻，正好掉到了她的头发上。也许是觉得头发的触感很不错，小羽兽就在这里安然地睡下了。当时时隙又哭了几个小时，最后天黑了才止住眼泪，一边安慰自己“阿梅利亚，你不能再没出息地哭了”一边回家。小羽兽也突然开了窍，在学会飞之前先学会了学人说话：“唧，唧唧！……没出息唧唧！”
Timeslot was of course none too pleased about that, but having a little creature at her side still beat gritting her teeth alone — provided the feathered beast did not pipe up with "Pathetic" every single time she cried.
Later, when she left home to study, she assumed the little feathered beast would be frightened off the moment she boarded the transport. Yet when she opened her luggage in the school dormitory, Timeslot found it lying belly-up, fast asleep. And at her university graduation, as the chancellor handed over her diploma, the little feathered beast popped up out of nowhere again to show off the new phrase it had only just learned: "Cheep, amazing, cheep cheep!"
It said that only that once, though — so much so that Timeslot half wondered whether she had simply imagined hearing it.
Later still — whether she was working overtime through the night at the office or resting back in the cheapest little rented room, the one with carrot strips hung up to dry — the little feathered beast would always come fluttering in, root through her hair to pick out a nest for itself, and burrow in for a comfortable sleep. Even on the day she slipped out of the office to run around making repairs, even when she charged into the sandstorm alongside Angelina and the others, the little feathered beast stayed right beside her. Only, during that stretch of time — whether out of shyness or newfound tact — it rarely spoke out of turn when Timeslot cried. Or perhaps it was simply that the reasons for her tears back then were not the usual ones.
The little feathered beast naturally came along when she came to Rhodes Island. Faced with Angelina and the others staring wide-eyed as it ate and drank, Timeslot finally had a chance to explain properly: this little thing they had all taken for a heavy-duty, feathered-beast-shaped "Little Flybug" was in fact a living feathered beast.
Lately, though, Timeslot feels that the little feathered beast hardly ever says "Pathetic" anymore — perhaps because she seldom cries these days, perhaps because there are a few more smiles on her face. So when will it say "Amazing" to her again?
Will it be tomorrow? Timeslot finds herself looking forward to it.
